name: ChangeRecordSet::ChangeRecordSet (thiscall)
notes: Lane IP. 0x24 bytes: the std::unordered_map (key sum hash, 16-byte equality; node 0x20) default-constructed (load factor 1, sentinel node, 16 bucket words all the sentinel, mask 7, max index 8) and the changed byte 0. Differential ChangeRecordSet_Construct, 50 seeds on 0xcc-filled memory: the returned pointer, every word of the table header, the sentinel links, the bucket vector (size, capacity, contents), the changed byte, then 20 inserts on each table (size, bucket count). Mutant: changed 1 killed. Mutants (build/ip_mut4.log, 17 over the class): 17/17 killed. Not yet run in-game.

name: ChangeRecordSet::Erase (thiscall, ret 4)
notes: Lane IP. When the key has an entry: it is erased (its object released, the node freed) and the set marked changed; else nothing. Differential ChangeRecordSet_Erase, 2000 seeds over seeded sets (0..24 entries, keys from a pool whose type+group+instance sums collide, some entries without an object): call log, table in list order, size, bucket count, changed flag, every count. Mutants: no changed flag, no presence test killed. Mutants (build/ip_mut4.log, 17 over the class): 17/17 killed. Not yet run in-game.

name: ChangeRecordSet::Take (thiscall, ret 0xc)
notes: Lane IP. The entry of the key: when its change id equals the argument, its object into *out with AddRef (no null check, as the original) and 1; otherwise the entry erased (not marked changed) and 0; 0 when absent. Differential ChangeRecordSet_Take, 2000 seeds (entries with a matching id always hold an object); result, out, log, table. Coverage: >= 200 hits. Mutants: AddRef dropped, erase dropped, >= for == killed. Mutants (build/ip_mut4.log, 17 over the class): 17/17 killed. Not yet run in-game.

name: ChangeRecordSet::Put (thiscall, ret 0xc)
notes: Lane IP. The entry of the key (try_emplace), a new 0x14-byte cRZVariant copied from the argument (our cRZVariant since lane LQ; the original calls its constructor 0x9c7a40), stored as the counted object (AddRef new, Release old when different), the change id stored, the set marked changed. Differential ChangeRecordSet_Put, 2000 seeds: the source a real variant of a seeded kind (lane LQ: the original side runs the image constructor 0x9c7a40, ours our class); log, table, counts, the copy's bytes and its vtable word against the side's own. Mutants: old object kept, change id dropped killed. Mutants (build/ip_mut4.log, 17 over the class): 17/17 killed. Not yet run in-game.

name: ChangeRecordSet::Read (thiscall, ret 4)
notes: Lane IP. clear() (objects released, nodes freed, buckets reset), then from the cIGZIStream: version (slot 13) == 1, count (slot 13), per entry the key (slot 25, a zeroed local), the entry (try_emplace), its change id (slot 13), the old object released and nulled, the object (slot 26). 0 at the first failed read, else 1. Differential ChangeRecordSet_Read, 3000 seeds: scripted streams (version 1 or not, 0..7 entries with duplicate and existing keys, objects or null, a failure at any step, garbage above al); log, result, table, counts. Coverage: >= 500 complete reads. Mutants: no clear, no version test, old object kept, change-id failure answering 1, one entry short killed. Mutants (build/ip_mut4.log, 17 over the class): 17/17 killed. Not yet run in-game.

name: ChangeRecordSet::Write (thiscall, ret 4)
notes: Lane IP. To the cIGZOStream: 1 and the size (slot 37), then per entry in list order the key (slot 49), change id (slot 37), object (slot 50); 0 at the first failed write, else 1 and the set marked unchanged. Differential ChangeRecordSet_Write, 2000 seeds with failures at any step; log, result, table. Mutants: flag kept, key word for change id, version 0 killed. Mutants (build/ip_mut4.log, 17 over the class): 17/17 killed. Not yet run in-game.
